name: result
measurement_notes: Controlled echo upstream, not external model service; small Python managed agents, 2 vCPU/1024 MiB/5184 MiB each.
All 512 upstream requests were held concurrently before release in each of five cycles.
Same runner and fixed deadlines as earlier failed relay tests: 180 seconds to park, 90 to reach upstream concurrency, 120 for response plus tool execution. SDK default commit retry budget.
Driver and echo upstream run on the gateway host; host CPU/memory samples include load generation.
HTTP rejection observer covers synchronous urllib only; asynchronous SDK retry counts were not instrumented. Success does not imply zero transient retries.
Periodic resource samples are not continuous peak measurements.
